email.label: Email
email.description: The address the user signs in with. Stored lowercased, so it stays unique across letter case.

password.label: Password
password.description: Takes a plaintext password and stores only its scrypt hash. The password itself is never stored.

user.label: User
user.description: The account this session belongs to.

tokenHash.label: Token hash
tokenHash.description: The hash of the session's cookie token. The raw token is never stored.

expiresAt.label: Expires at
expiresAt.description: When the session stops being valid, as epoch milliseconds.
